description:
University degree corresponding to Level 7 of the European Qualifications Framework (which typically corresponds to a master’s level or 5 years of higher education), and a minimum 5 years of IT professional experience
Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written, corresponding to Level B2
Proficiency with fundamental front-end languages (JavaScript, HTML, CSS) and experience with frameworks/libraries including Vaadin 7, Angular, React, Vue, and Bootstrap.
Expertise in Java 8/17 and back-end stacks (Java/Node/PHP), including JEE (EJB 3, CDI, JMS), Spring Boot, and Hibernate JPA.
Advanced experience in designing, building, and securing RESTful APIs and web services using Kafka, Protobuf, JAX-WS, JAXB, and OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.
Proficiency with Oracle Database, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB, including schema design, query optimization, and version control with Flyway.
Strong understanding of application servers, specifically Weblogic 12c and 14.
Experience with modern build and dependency management tools such as Maven, Webpack, and Vite.
Solid background in automated testing and related tooling, e.g., JUnit 4 and Mockito.
Expert knowledge of Git workflows (GitFlow, trunk-based) using GitLab and Bitbucket, with an understanding of legacy systems using SVN.
Knowledge of cloud services (AWS, Azure) and experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Azure Bicep for environment provisioning.
Understanding of containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) for application deployment. Deep knowledge of authentication and authorization protocols and standards (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT).
Proven experience working within Agile methodologies and using JIRA for task and project management.
Ability to write clear, structured technical specifications for AI code agents (e.g., Kiro, GitHub Copilot).
Awareness of AI limitations
